text:
Three things that make Google suspicious of a local business:

Keywords tacked onto your business name. Reviews that came from a deal, a swap or your cousin. A PO box or virtual office as your address.

Any one can get your profile suspended or restricted. Clean them up before Google finds them.

A bakery in Sandy Bay puts its Christmas hours on Google. The website still shows last year's.

Someone suggests the old hours. The email lands in an inbox nobody reads.

Google gives you four days to reject an edit, then can publish it if your website backs it up.

Match the website first.

Your Google business name should match your van and your invoices.

"Smith Plumbing Emergency Plumber Geelong 24/7" (good luck fitting that on a van) could get your profile suspended.

Keywords go in services, categories and description.
